n01.roman: Motor Vehicles Act ki dhaara 184 mein, 2019 se likha hai: red light jump karna, khatarnaak driving hai.

n02.roman: Pehli baar: ₹1,000 se ₹5,000 tak jurmana, ya 6 mahine se 1 saal tak jail, ya dono.

n03.roman: 3 saal ke andar dobaara? 2 saal tak jail, ya ₹10,000 jurmana, ya dono.

n04.roman: Twist: Delhi Traffic Police ki list mein iska fixed jurmana nahi, 'court challan' hai: rakam court tay karega!

n05.roman: Aur licence points? Abhi sirf Ministry ka prastaav. Par 2026 ke naye niyam se, saal mein 5 ya zyada offences par licence par action ho sakta hai.

n06.roman: Game mein bas ek button, asli mein jurmana, jail, ya dono!
